**NOTICE TYPE:** M-C031324-01 Operations
**SHORT DESCRIPTION**: Notifications of Suspension of Operations (NSOs) for CPS Energy (BRAUNIG\_VHB1, BRAUNIG\_VHB2, BRAUNIG\_VHB3)
**INTENDED AUDIENCE:** ERCOT Market Participants
**DAY AFFECTED:** Comments Due April 3, 2024
**LONG DESCRIPTION:** On March 13, 2024, ERCOT received three (3) NSOs for the following Generation Resources:
- CPS Energy (BRAUNIG\_VHB1, BRAUNIG\_VHB2, BRAUNIG\_VHB3)
The NSOs indicate that, as of March 31, 2025, the Generation Resources will indefinitely suspend operations. The NSOs further indicate that the Generation Resources have a summer Seasonal Net Max Sustainable Rating of:
- BRAUNIG\_VHB1 ( **217 MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB2 ( **230 MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB3 ( **412 MW**)
and a summer Seasonal Net Minimum Sustainable Rating of:
- BRAUNIG\_VHB1 ( **60** **MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB2 ( **60** **MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB3 ( **70** **MW**)
Pursuant to ERCOT Protocol section 3.14.1.2(1), copies of the NSOs are posted under the Notice of Suspension of Operations portion of the [Generation](https://mis.ercot.com/secure/data-products/grid/generation) page of the ERCOT Market Information System (MIS) Secure Area.  An ERCOT Digital Certificate is required to access the MIS.  
**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:** Please send any comments you may have regarding the NSOs to [mailto:[log in to unmask]](mailto:[log in to unmask] "mailto:[log in to unmask]")[\[log in to unmask\]](https://lists.ercot.com/cgi-bin/wa?LOGON=A3%3D2403%26L%3DNOTICE_CONTRACTS%26E%3Dquoted-printable%26P%3D860%26B%3D------%253D_Part_532_1003682743.1710364219618%26T%3Dtext%252Fhtml%3B%2520charset%3Dutf-8%26pending%3D), with “CPS Energy (BRAUNIG\_VHB1, BRAUNIG\_VHB2, BRAUNIG\_VHB3) NSOs” in the subject line.  Comments are due no later than April 3, 2024. All comments will be posted to the [Generation](https://mis.ercot.com/secure/data-products/grid/generation) page of the MIS Secure Area.
**CONTACT:** If you have any questions, please contact your ERCOT Account Manager. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at [\[log in to unmask\]](https://lists.ercot.com/cgi-bin/wa?LOGON=A3%3D2403%26L%3DNOTICE_CONTRACTS%26E%3Dquoted-printable%26P%3D860%26B%3D------%253D_Part_532_1003682743.1710364219618%26T%3Dtext%252Fhtml%3B%2520charset%3Dutf-8%26pending%3D).
